en_face_paragraph.verbatim: **AI 味英文词面（20261010 三席收集·处置＝避用或按替代形·词频证据见 Kobak et al. 2025 *Science Advances*／Gray 2024／Liang et al. 2024 arXiv:2403.07183；全表见回执 PIU1698R/1699R）**：delve／underscore／leverage／foster／showcase／underscore／meticulous／intricate／nuanced／multifaceted／interplay／holistic／pivotal／realm／tapestry／comprehensive（超额词频实证族）——叙述面以直陈替代（explore／examine／important 等中性形按语境）；句式族＝It is worth noting that／In the realm of／serves as／plays a crucial role in／sheds light on／paves the way for／Furthermore-Morever-Additionally 段首链／not only...but also／in conclusion（删或直陈）；结构族＝em-dash 插入语（每千字符 ≤1）／rule of three／等长段（P2 防误伤）。**评审工具链对照**（检测在评审流程的位置·非我方闸口）：Turnitin/iThenticate（查重＋AI 检测）·GPTZero·Originality.ai·Sapling·ZeroGPT（AI 检测）·Writefull·Paperpal·Trinka·Grammarly Academic（语言质量）·Statcheck（统计）·Proofig·ImageTwin（图像）·PubPeer（社区核查）；COPE 裁定＝检测器结果不一致时编辑不应单靠检测器判罚。

transcription_notes: Verbatim policy: canon_excerpts quote the canon byte-faithfully, including the duplicated 'underscore' token in en_face_paragraph and the 'Morever' spelling in the paragraph-initial chain. The map is keyed by face, so the duplicated token yields one face; face keys use the detector's standard spellings.

Glossary 5 enumerates 15 distinct English stem faces (the duplicated 'underscore' collapses to one); the operating mirror (constraint-blocks section 13) lists 14, omitting 'comprehensive'. This map follows glossary 5 and the detector (15 stems, comprehensive included).

The detector's sentence branch for 'plays a crucial role in' is broader than the register literal (five role adjectives, optional article). Transcribed as-is; flagged in en-sent-04; the register itself was not widened.

Register row A also lists 颗粒度 (C level, sourced weakly, use with care). It is not part of the detector battery and is therefore not among the 36 faces; recorded here only through the verbatim row A quote.

The instrument groups the 10 Chinese faces under one battery echo label (CH_3FAMILIES_10FACES) without a per-face family assignment; the register likewise treats them as one row. No speculative per-face family taxonomy was invented here.

This file is RED under its own battery by design: the data is the battery (the canon excerpts and face keys contain the faces). Same exclusion rationale as the instrument, which states its own pattern literals are excluded from its own assertion.

Snapshot discipline: this file is a read-only transcription snapshot. The canon under D:/ComplexAnalysis/规范术语/ remains the sole maintenance point; amendments go there first, and this snapshot follows it per the sync discipline carried by the seed package.
